headline: Sabres’ Konsta Helenius to miss next two games with upper-body injury
take:
Daily Faceoff reports that Buffalo's Konsta Helenius will miss the next two games with an upper-body injury. He has one goal and three points in 11 games with the Sabres this season.

The numbers say the Sabres lose a useful depth piece, not a driver. Helenius has scored one goal against 1.15 expected goals so far this season (expected goals measures the quality of the chances a player is on the ice for), so his output sits almost exactly where his chances say it should. At five-on-five, BUF holds 51 percent of the expected goals when he plays, a small plus, and he averages about 13 minutes a night. The team is 5-4-3 with 51 percent of the expected goals overall, so this is an average club, and a two-game absence for a third-liner shouldn't shift that much. Going by how the coach has used his players, Tyson Kozak, who plays 12:16 a night, is next in line for those minutes.
